description: RFC 0001 R18: the only first-party files that include an SDL header or call an SDL function. SDL3 is a private dependency of the window provider (appframework's launcher manager), the input system, the engine's audio backends, the composition roots (launcher_main, render_lab's host), the SDL3 platform module and presentation bridges, and their native tests. Everything else asks the launcher through ILauncherPlatformServices or tier0's platform message box. Checked by tools/quality/sdl_boundary.py: shrink-only, exact (a listed file that no longer uses SDL must be removed).
